description: Update an Agent ID's profile: pins a new registration file and returns the UNSIGNED setAgentURI(agentId, agentURI) transaction, sent by the ID's owner (or an approved operator). Pass only what changes: the new file is the current one exactly as stored with only those fields changed, so everything else (other services, OASF, supportedTrust, active, x402Support, other registrations) is kept as it is, and an empty string removes a link. When the current file cannot be read, pass name and description to start a fresh one. The new file always names the ID itself in its registrations, so call this once right after prepare_agent_id lands even with nothing to change. Names claiming the ubi.fun brand (UBI, ubi.fun and the like) are reserved, as for coins.

a2a.description: New A2A agent card URL (https link); an empty string removes it

description.description: New description of what the agent does, 1 to 1000 characters

imageBase64.description: The image as base64, up to about 700 KB

imageCid.description: An image already on IPFS (a CID from upload_token_metadata or an earlier profile)

imageUrl.description: Public https image (PNG, JPEG, GIF or WebP, up to 5 MB)

mcp.description: New MCP endpoint of the agent's own (https link); an empty string removes it

wallet.description: The wallet that will send the update: the owner or an approved operator

website.description: New website (https link); an empty string removes it

x.description: New X account (@handle or https://x.com/handle); an empty string removes it

name: prepare_agent_id_update
